whole lab fits one screen (no vertical scroll)
every button is at least 44x44 css px
stage is square and inside the viewport
touch on the lid starts folding
finger on the fold line = ~90deg
still folding until release
contact is tracked while down
release past the threshold commits the fold
contact released
touch on the seam starts sealing
next is blocked while the seal finger is down (sealing)
partial stroke seals some, not all, segments
a full stroke seals all 36 segments
folded again
off-band touch leaves the phase `folded`
...yet the contact is tracked
next is blocked by contact, not by phase
next works once nothing is in contact
short drag springs back to idle
touchcancel cancels the fold and releases contact

とじる x4 seals all 36 segments
next after the button path
前の工程を変える discards everything
an unsealed run is drawn as a gap
insufficient seal never blocks the step
prefers-reduced-motion removes the lid transition
no page errors / console errors
